prompt: Edit ONLY clothing in this original photorealistic 3D ADULT DeepSeek 1536x1024 4-column 2-row 8-frame care atlas. Preserve adult facial identity, LONG adult legs, poses and original body size. TOP row: comb hair with brown brush, preserve brush and hand. BOTTOM row: wipe face with cream towel, preserve towel and hand/cheek contact; towel is not a sleeve. Keep original ankle/foot places and difference in sizes between two rows. This is a clothing edit of the SAME original character, not a redesign. Preserve original face, exact head size, hair/headband/ears/tail, expression, each hand/wrist/hip/knee/ankle position, pose, perspective, figure height and location on the source canvas. Outfit: white zip-front athletic shirt, NAVY short upper-arm sleeves with cyan piping and small blue whale chest emblem; navy above-knee athletic SHORTS with thin white side stripes; bare forearms without white cuffs, bare knees and lower legs, white ankle socks and small white/navy sneakers. Never shorten legs, enlarge head, thicken body, change a pose, or move a prop. Genuine transparent alpha outside all characters and props. No backdrop, captions, grid, extra effects or shadow.
